facts.fact: MyJoyOnline reports the Accra High Court on 16 December 2025 convicted Nana Agradaa under the Cybersecurity Act, 2020 (Act 1038) on a plea bargain, fining her GHS12,000 and ordering GHS50,000 compensation.
